text:
sara: heads-up — ran into a weird conversion quirk from HF jinja chat_template -> Redwood prompt formatter.
sara: small repro below, gist: an explicit assistant message that is only a newline (\n) gets dropped and the following assistant content gets glued into the previous user line.
sara: ```jinja
- role: system
  content: |-
    You are a helpful assistant.
- role: user
  content: |-
    Explain HTTP in simple terms.
- role: assistant
  content: "\n"
- role: assistant
  content: |-
    Keep it short, 3 bullets.
```
mike: can you paste what the converter is producing? :eyes:
sara: sure — converted prompt (simplified):
```
System: You are a helpful assistant.
User: Explain HTTP in simple terms.Keep it short, 3 bullets.
```
mike: ugh — the newline-only assistant got removed and the separation between user/assistant boundaries collapsed.
jenna: this smells like a renderer/trimming rule — we historically strip purely-whitespace messages in the jinja pre-render, assuming they're accidental. but here newline is meaningful as an explicit assistant turn separator.
ian: also check model config.json / tokenizer special tokens. some HF models map assistant markers to special tokens that are "invisible" (eg empty string or newline) which the converter then treats as no-op.
ian: if config has e.g. "assistant_token": "" or "assistant_sep": "\n" we need to preserve it as a sentinel during conversion instead of dropping.
mike: any regression risk if we change behavior? like evals failing on prompt counts or token deltas?
jenna: yes — quantized runs are especially sensitive. we saw INT8 variant tokenizing lone "\n" as a different sequence, shifting token ids downstream and breaking exact-match evals for some prompts.
jenna: suggestion: conversion step -> replace explicit empty assistant with a stable sentinel token like "<assistant-empty>" (not a real token, just placeholder) then render to Redwood with explicit role markers, then strip sentinel only at delivery-time if model expects it.
sara: that sounds reasonable. quick patch idea: in jinja preprocessor, if message.content.strip() == "" and role == 'assistant' -> set content = '<assistant-empty>' and mark metadata.keep_empty = true.
ian: also add unit tests: chat_template_conversion_test.py::test_preserve_empty_assistant and tokenization smoke for quantized models.
deploy-bot: CI job #4821 finished: 2 failing, 58 passed. Fails: chat_template_conversion_test::test_preserve_empty_assistant and hf-tokenizer-int8-smoke.
mike: glad CI caught it. i'll queue a tiny PR that implements sentinel approach and adds the two tests.
sara: thank you! i'll add a reproducer with the model config that shows assistant_sep mapping.
jenna: after fix, run full eval suite on the INT8 build — we should check token deltas and a few golden prompts.
ian: also document in migration notes: "If your HF chat_template relies on empty assistant messages as separators, enable preserve_empty_assistant flag in converter."
sara: pinging @mike when PR is up. :thumbsup:
mike: will do, expect a draft in ~30m.
jenna: leaving a note for support: customers may see weird one-line merges in chat responses during onboarding; give them the workaround (preserve_empty_assistant) until deployed.
